name: Cendrillon
summary: Cendrillon is defined by the strength of hard leather that wraps the seat and back in a sleek, tailored finish. Its metal legs are painted in deep black for a bold foundation, while the upper section reveals a brushed copper-plated detail in stainless steel, catching the light with subtle warmth. With this interplay of texture and tone, it carries a striking presence that blends modern confidence with timeless elegance. 62x58x76
